thread:
maya: Heads-up — quiet window prep for the cross-service rollout on 2026-06-02 02:00 UTC. Need alignment across API, runtime, console, router. :wave:

samir: Copy. What are the pinned versions right now?

jonah: Runtime 1.2.0 (pinned), Router 1.2.0, API stable 2026-05, Console scheduled to move to 1.3.0-beta in the same window unless we delay.

eli: Console migration has a header-shape tweak that might break router header parsing — small change but lots of downstream assumptions. I recommend delaying console until after the runtime/router shift.

maya: Agreed. Proposal: do API + runtime + router in this window; hold console migration to a follow-up window. Can we confirm rollback criteria and deploy-bot flags?

deploy-bot: queued wave 7643 for 2026-06-02T02:00:00Z. Planned flags: --stagger=7m --traffic-steps=10,10,10,10,10 --pin=runtime:1.2.0,router:1.2.1 --dry-run=false. Will emit health checks at each step.

samir: Quick note — router team pushed a small patch to 1.2.1 to tolerate the console header attr but it hasn't been smoke-tested end-to-end with current runtime KV eviction settings. We should pin router to 1.2.0 and stage 1.2.1 as a canary after this window unless we run a short smoke before traffic shift.

maya: Let's be conservative: pin router to 1.2.0 for the main shift. After 30m of stable telemetry, we can lift and deploy 1.2.1 to a small shard. Update deploy-bot flags accordingly.

jonah: Rollback triggers proposal: auto-rollback if >= 0.5% 5xx across the service for 3 consecutive steps OR if p95 latency > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive steps. Manual rollback if errors spike but not meet auto threshold. Thoughts?

eli: Agree. Add a KV cache miss spike check — if cache hit rate drops by >7% sustained across the runtime pool, pause rollout and revert routing to previous variant. Also alert SLO slack with pager if any of the above happens.

ops-oncall: I'll own pager for the window. Suggest we add a short preflight smoke at T-30m: run this script against staging and a small prod shadow slice:

```bash
./deploy-smoke.sh --endpoints api,router,runtime --payload samples/long-context.json
# expect: no 500s, p95 latency < 300ms, kv-hit > 92%
```

deploy-bot: preflight checklist acknowledged. Will run smoke at 2026-06-02T01:30:00Z and post results here. If smoke fails, rollout will stay in queue and send a HOLD.

maya: Documenting final plan:
- Preflight smoke T-30m
- Main wave: API + Runtime + Router (router pinned to 1.2.0) at T0
- Traffic shift: 10% increments every 7 minutes, health gating at each step
- Console migration deferred to a follow-up window (TBD)
- Auto-rollback thresholds: 5xx >= 0.5% sustained, p95 > 2x baseline, kv-hit drop >7%
- On-call: ops-oncall, notify console-team and eng-platform on any freeze

samir: I'm going to add a quick extra smoke: synthetic user journey for function calling and streaming to ensure runtime kv and streaming kernel path behave under load. If you want, I can paste the load command.

maya: Please paste it. We'll include it in the preflight.

samir: Paste below:
```bash
wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s --script=streaming.lua http://staging-api.internal/v1/chat/stream
# validate: no partial responses > 0.1%, no connection resets
```

eli: One more operational item: console-team, we need a post-rollout migration checklist to run once API/runtime/router are stable. Please confirm you can freeze console DB migrations until we greenlight.

console-team: Confirmed we will freeze console DB migrations and the UI schema push until we get an explicit :shipit: in this thread. We'll prepare a rollback plan if we need to revert console client assets.

ops-oncall: I'll set the pager threshold and channel alerting. Also adding a canary shard with increased telemetry retention for 1 hour post-rollout.

deploy-bot: preflight complete @1768884600. Smoke results: api OK, router OK (sanity), runtime kv hit 93.6%. No 500s observed in staging. Ready for T0 queue.

maya: Thanks. Locking plan and updating release notes: summary + rollback criteria + pinned versions. I'll put the release note snippet in the release tracker and link after this thread. :memo:

jonah: One last ask — please add a manual opt-out for the stagger in case we need to push the whole fleet quickly. deploy-bot, is there an override?

deploy-bot: override available: `/deploy abort-stagger --wave 7643 --reason "urgent all-in"` — requires two approvers from eng-releases and eng-sre.

maya: Great. Unless anyone objects, we'll proceed with the plan and start the preflight at T-30. :eyes:

eli: No objections from me.

samir: Good to go from runtime side.

console-team: Thanks — standing by for the post-rollout window.

ops-oncall: Oncall ready. Will update channel on each step.

maya: Okay locked. I'll post the release note link in 10 minutes and pin this thread to the channel. :lock:
